profile.grammar_notes: Two copulas: ser (identity) and estar (location, current state); hay for existence; tener for possession and tener que for obligation; pronoun subjects usually dropped; negation with no before the verb; yes/no questions by intonation, question words are a closed set; tú/usted politeness marked in verb endings (ustedes for plural in Latin America); gustar-type verbs put the liked thing as subject; ir a + infinitive for near future; closed sets: subject pronouns, articles, question words, weekdays.
